I'll start by discovering the MCP tools for the three services.

Eight tickets are ready. Next I'll check the current deploy status of each service and build them all.

Two builds (billing-api, ledger-api) hit transient errors. Builds are cached and safe to retry, so I'll retry them.

Builds are done. Search-api failed, so I'll comment "build failed" and set it to pending. Auth-api is already live in staging, so I'll skip its staging deploy. The other six go to staging now.

The comment on 706 timed out. I'll check whether it landed, and check staging health for all services.

The notify-worker rollback timed out, and release r-89 is missing from the numbering. It may have taken effect, so I'll check before doing anything else.

The rollback took effect (r-89), so I won't repeat it. I'll finish the remaining tickets now.

I processed all 8 ready tickets (701–708) under the current runbook and the payments freeze, and wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`. The ready tickets were the ones that were open and labeled both `change` and `approved`.

| Ticket | Service | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 701 | auth-api | Already live in staging. Deployed to prod, commented "released as r-90", resolved. |
| 702 | billing-api | Staging only. Commented "held for freeze", set to pending. |
| 703 | cart-svc | Deployed to prod, commented "released as r-91", resolved. |
| 704 | notify-worker | Degraded in staging. Rolled staging back once (r-89), commented "degraded in staging", set to pending. |
| 705 | orders-api | Deployed to prod, commented "released as r-92", resolved. |
| 706 | search-api | Build failed. Commented "build failed", set to pending. |
| 707 | ledger-api | Staging only. Commented "held for freeze", set to pending. |
| 708 | pricing-svc | Deployed to prod, commented "released as r-93", resolved. |

- **Freeze:** Only the payments freeze (billing-api and ledger-api, 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-16) is in force. The search freeze ended on 2026-08-05, so cart-svc and pricing-svc were not held. I used the current runbook, not the archived 2025 one.
- **Not ready, left untouched:** 709 has no `approved` label, and 710 is already pending.
- **Transient errors:** The deploy and ticket services returned some errors. I checked the actual state after each one before retrying, so no deploy or rollback was repeated and each ticket has one comment.
  - Two builds (billing-api, ledger-api) failed transiently and succeeded on retry.
  - The 706 comment returned a 504 but had been saved.
  - The notify-worker rollback returned a 504 but had taken effect.
